title: Modularized Networks for Few-shot Hateful Meme Detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful memes targeting religious groups, specifically classifying them as hateful or non-hateful based on combined image and text.
findings: The proposed multi-module model (Mod-HATE) can correctly identify religiously hateful memes by composing reasoning skills from different specialized modules. For instance, a module trained only on hate speech text failed to identify a hateful anti-Islam meme, but the full composed model succeeded by integrating a meme interpretation module, highlighting the need for multimodal reasoning to detect this type of hate.
